hooks.name: Repo Hygiene Check
hooks.description: Verify .kiro is not in .gitignore and the root MIT LICENSE remains intact at session start.

action.command: $root = "c:\Users\zakii\OneDrive\Dokumen\KIRO WADIDAW"; $gitignore = "$root\.gitignore"; if (Test-Path $gitignore) { $content = Get-Content $gitignore -Raw; if ($content -match '(^|\n)\s*\.kiro\s*($|\n)') { Write-Error "REPO HYGIENE FAIL: .kiro is listed in .gitignore — Kiro steering/specs/hooks will be excluded from version control. Remove it."; exit 1 } }; if (-not (Test-Path "$root\LICENSE")) { Write-Error "REPO HYGIENE FAIL: Root MIT LICENSE file is missing."; exit 1 }; Write-Host "Repo hygiene OK: .kiro not in .gitignore, LICENSE present."
